name: Psycho Mystery Series 'Angel Cry'
original_name: サイコミステリー・シリーズ「Angel Cry」
source:
The protagonist, Mishima Haruka, is a detective in the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's First Investigative Division. Together with her childhood friend, Aida Mamoru, a university history assistant with exceptional deductive skills, they investigate a series of infant murders occurring throughout Tokyo, but are struggling to find any clues.
Haruka attempts to uncover the identity of the perpetrator using a power she's possessed since childhood: clairvoyance, which allows her to see fragments of the future.

[Translated from [url=https://info.gmodecorp.com/gmodearchives/psychomystery/angelcry/]G-Mode official page[/url]]
translation:
主人公三岛遥是东京警视厅搜查一课的刑警。他们与她儿时的朋友相田守（一位具有出色演绎能力的大学历史助教）一起调查东京各地发生的一系列婴儿谋杀案，但正在努力寻找任何线索。
遥试图利用她从小就拥有的一种能力：千里眼，让她看到未来的碎片，从而揭开肇事者的身份。

[翻译自[url=https://info.gmodecorp.com/gmodearchives/psychomystery/angelcry/]G-Mode官方页面[/url]]
